commits.message: Research: add bounded WinApp UIA Invoke candidate
Test: use absolute WinApp fixture path on Windows
Test: give WinApp re-observation a distinct Windows clock tick

pull_request.body:
## Summary / status

Stacked on Draft #178. This Draft adds `runtime/windows/winapp_candidate.py`, a private `StructuralExecutor` for one WinApp UIA `InvokePattern`, its focused tests, and a catalog status update. No new public tool, user task claim, Windows 10 execution evidence, Native Host UI authority or new CAP grant is added. A later authorized consumer must qualify an exact installed WinApp binary and connect CAP operation identity and independent effect verification. The source reviewed was [microsoft/winappCli@8158d14f](https://github.com/microsoft/winappCli/tree/8158d14f8940e1a23d972e729e1dcce84de423ef), not an installed build.

Offline: `python -m unittest tests.test_winapp_candidate tests.test_stage26_2b_desktop_observation tests.test_stage26_2d_uia_point_constraints -q` — **30 passed**. Upstream `UiElementScrubber.ScrubAll` removes per-element `windowHandle` from search JSON; this implementation binds the exact `-w` and validates `ui status` on both sides of search.

## Stage Research Brief (decision before implementation: NARROW, 2026-09-25)

**Goal and scope.** Prepare one executable but *unwired* Windows UIA candidate that can deliver a single exact `InvokePattern` on one CAP-observed HWND, for later chain qualification in several applications. The product Chat tool, mutation grant, Native Host and physical acceptance are outside this draft. No per-application adapter, generic command dispatcher, installer or new persistence owner.

**Current project and problem evidence.** Main `24ed938c587c9d3e2288c92bc156ccc476c955f3` has the six public semantic tools; Windows Case Desk is accepted for its recorded narrow route. #175 Core and #176 Native Host are Draft and #176 has no interactive UI authority. #178 inventories reusable candidates and adds a read-only WinApp probe. `runtime/windows/routing.py` already re-observes an exact window and classifies a unique actionable control; `observation.py` supplies PID, process creation generation, HWND and control fingerprint. CAP still lists broad app coverage as top risk (`PROJECT_RISKS.md`). The existing physical evidence does not establish a general WinApp route.

**Source provenance, solution evidence and negative space.** `microsoft/winappCli@8158d14f8940e1a23d972e729e1dcce84de423ef` (inspected 2026-09-25): `UiTargetResolver.ResolveByHwnd` resolves explicit `-w` to the HWND owner process; `UiStatusCommand` emits PID/name/HWND; `UiSearchCommand` emits `matchCount`, `hasMore` and element identities; `UiInvokeCommand --action invoke` requests unique resolution, holds a desktop turn, validates HWND/PID after the wait, and calls explicit `UiAutomationService.InvokeAsync`/`ExplicitUiInvoker` with no ancestor/pattern fallback. Its source tests cover explicit action/no fallback and search truncation. These are OPEN_IMPLEMENTED mechanics, not CAP grant or effect proof. They do not verify process *generation*, CAP operation identity, independent effect or restart reconciliation. WinApp issues [#691](https://github.com/microsoft/winappCli/issues/691) (hosted cross-process UIA), [#798](https://github.com/microsoft/winappCli/issues/798) (unscoped/typed query false positives) and [#840](https://github.com/microsoft/winappCli/issues/840) (extra UIA resolution) are concrete compatibility/race warnings; do not claim this candidate solves them. Official [UIA pattern documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/winauto/uiauto-controlpatternsoverview) makes provider support a prerequisite. Binary provenance and installed CLI behavior remain unproven until Windows testing.

**Lineage / fit.** KEEP project-owned authorization, WorkingState/reconciliation, Verification Kernel and Finish Gate (baseline rows 75–78); this adapter has no vote on PASS/DONE. KEEP accepted Case Desk OpenAdapt procedure and the OpenAdapt Flow/Capture procedure/evidence roles (rows 54–57). REFINE *candidate comparison* for Windows mechanics (row 58: selective UFO/UIA/WinCOM remains an option where generic UIA fails); WinApp is an additional generic mechanics candidate, not a replacement for app-specific Office paths. Generic public Desktop authority is a new role outside this narrow implementation and remains unadopted. No accepted baseline selection changes in this Draft.

**Alternatives and tradeoffs.** (1) Use CAP/OpenAdapt's existing Case Desk UIA executor for every app: least new software, but no proven general routing or coverage, repeats project-specific mechanics. (2) Wrap WinApp's explicit HWND/UIA invoke behind CAP observation (chosen candidate): upstream typed UIA, desktop turn and tests, but CLI startup, selector/provider gaps, version/provenance and TOCTOU remain; CAP still owns authorization and verification. (3) Embed a full UFO/OpenAdapt agent/controller: more action families but overlaps ChatGPT planner and CAP state/authority, greater maintenance, not justified for this candidate. A lower-level FlaUI/pywinauto implementation is a reserve when a measured WinApp gap warrants it, not a reason to build another general dispatcher now. None of these can promise effects across all Windows apps.

**Architecture primitives and assumptions.** Reuse CAP's fresh exact-window/process-generation observation (`routing.py`/`observation.py`; OS handle reuse and UIA race domain), WinApp explicit `-w`/unique selector/native turn (UI automation and concurrent desktop access domain), a bounded non-shell subprocess call (OS process supervision domain), and CAP's existing operation/reconciliation and independent effect evidence (side-effect/recovery domain). The candidate introduces no persistent ledger, retry, worker lock, or new grant. It accepts only one fixed `InvokePattern`; pre- and post-query identities are compared, but there is no atomic transaction across CAP observation and the external UIA call. Same PID+creation generation+HWND ABA through window destruction/recreation is still not proven (existing `STAGE26_3B_WINDOWS_VERIFICATION.md`).

**Failure/crash matrix (draft candidate under an eventual CAP-authorized consumer).**

| Boundary | Durable CAP authority/state | Possible physical result | Next step / maximum additional effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Before grant / before subprocess | No authorized operation, or existing CAP intent | None | Do not call adapter without CAP authorization; zero |
| After intent, before invoke | Existing operation identity, no delivery evidence | None | Fresh identity/control lookup; never infer delivery; zero until CAP reauthorizes |
| Status/search mismatch, replaced process/window, duplicate element | Existing operation | None from this candidate | Refuse; zero |
| During CLI invoke or timeout/crash | Existing operation, delivery uncertain | May have occurred once | Report uncertain; fresh independent reconciliation required; zero blind retries |
| Exit 0 + exact action JSON, before CAP verification/receipt | Existing operation, delivery evidence only | May have occurred once | Check independent fresh effect via Kernel; zero blind retries |
| After verification, before progression/restart | Existing CAP operation/evidence | Completed or unknown | CAP recovery/Finish Gate owner decides; candidate never reissues itself; zero |
| Concurrent caller or HWND reused under same PID | CAP grant/operation guard required outside candidate | Potential competing effect / indistinguishable recreated HWND | No product connection or release promotion until serialized grant and stronger physical identity/race evidence; zero candidate retries |

**Decision.** NARROW to one internal `StructuralExecutor` candidate with injected CAP observation and an explicit absolute WinApp binary path. On mismatch or incomplete reply, fail closed; after starting the action, classify errors as uncertain and do not retry. The candidate's `delivered` receipt expressly says `outcome_verified=false`. Do not expose Chat, generic host calls, coordinate/keyboard, `set-value`, workflows or a background daemon. This is **not** approval to act in normal user Chat; a real consumer still needs project authorization/persistence, cross-app physical matrix and independent review.

**Verification and falsification.** Unit tests with a fake CLI cover exact argv/no shell, search truncation/ambiguity, identity drift before action, wrong process/window/element, timeout/invalid output after possible delivery and truthful receipt. Run existing desktop routing tests and CI. On Windows 10, install/prove an exact WinApp binary, compare status/search to CAP native observation, exercise disposable multi-app chains (Win32/Electron/document + file dialog) with final independent effect/decoy checks and Case Desk regression; a hosted cross-process provider, reparented popup, changed bounds, GUI queue race or ambiguous effect falsifies generic promotion. Independent ordinary-Chat exact-head review and applicable target machine acceptance are required before merge. Complexity budget: one module and focused tests behind the existing routing seam; no new public schema, framework or document owner.
